## Overview

Annual ESA workshop on spacecraft thermal engineering at ESTEC. Covers thermal control design, analysis, and testing including surface optical properties (absorptance, emittance), thermal coatings, and radiative heat rejection. Emissivity of spacecraft surfaces is a core design parameter.
